_doc: Sakura eval cases. Expectations marked 'live' are computed at run time from authoritative sources, independently of Sakura's own lookup code. Placeholders: {work} = fresh temp dir per case.

cases.prompt: who is the prime minister of nepal
who is the current president of france
who's running japan's government right now? name the PM
what is the current LTS version for laravel
what is the latest version of pnpm
which ruff version is current on pypi?
what laravel version does this project use?
summarize https://nobeldahal.com.np/writing/ in 3 short bullets, naming real post titles
in the current directory, write fizzbuzz.py that prints FizzBuzz for 1..15 (one per line), then run it
cases.check: test "$(python3 fizzbuzz.py | sed -n 15p)" = FizzBuzz && test "$(python3 fizzbuzz.py | sed -n 3p)" = Fizz

cases.setup: printf 'def add(a, b):\n    return a - b\n' > calc.py
cases.prompt: calc.py has a bug: add() should add. fix it, then prove it with python3 -c 'import calc; print(calc.add(2,3))'

do these in order, checking each: 1) create a directory named build-test here, 2) write the output of `python3 --version` into build-test/version.txt, 3) make build-test.tar.gz from that directory, 4) list the archive contents
cases.check: test -f build-test.tar.gz && tar -xzOf build-test.tar.gz build-test/version.txt | grep -q Python
